solves.reasoning: ABC 원문대조: (A) conducted(P1, survey conducted) + (B) proportion(P2, the proportion of) + (C) occasionally(P4, at least occasionally). ①이 3개 원문 일치.
ABC: (A) highest(P1, the highest percentage) + (B) outnumbered(P3, outnumbered those expecting more) + (C) exceeded(P5, exceeded that of). ③이 3개 원문 일치.
ABC: (A) largest(P2+P5, largest gap/share) + (B) foresaw(P3, a third foresaw) + (C) approximately(P5, approximately 15 Mt). ②이 3개 원문 일치.
③ half ≠ 원문 twice. 전화통화가 문자의 '두 배 이상(more than twice)'이므로 half은 부적절.
④ identical ≠ 원문 opposite. 유럽만 '반대 패턴(the opposite pattern)'인데 identical(동일한)은 반대 의미.
① eliminated ≠ 원문 generated. e-waste를 '발생시킨(generated)'인데 eliminated(제거)는 반대 의미.

conducted = carried out (실시하다/수행하다). 정확한 동의어.
foresaw = anticipated (예상했다). foresee의 과거형.
exceeded = surpassed (초과하다/능가하다).
common(흔한) ↔ rare(드문). 정확한 반의어.
former(전자) ↔ latter(후자). 정확한 반의어 쌍.

a place where people are going or being sent = destination(목적지).

collect → collection. collection rates = 수거율.
